description: This file contains implementation of Diffie-Hellman (DH) cryptographic operations, including key generation, computation, and management functions, as well as specific DH parameter sets.

methods.name: DH_new
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new DH structure with default values.

methods.name: DH_free
methods.description: Frees the DH structure and associated resources.

methods.name: DH_bits
methods.description: Returns the number of bits in the prime modulus p.

methods.name: DH_get0_pub_key
methods.description: Returns the public key component.

methods.name: DH_get0_priv_key
methods.description: Returns the private key component.

methods.name: DH_get0_p
methods.description: Returns the prime modulus p.

methods.name: DH_get0_q
methods.description: Returns the subgroup order q.

methods.name: DH_get0_g
methods.description: Returns the generator g.

methods.name: DH_get0_key
methods.description: Retrieves the public and private key components.

methods.name: DH_set0_key
methods.description: Sets the public and private key components.

methods.name: DH_get0_pqg
methods.description: Retrieves the parameters p, q, g.

methods.name: DH_set0_pqg
methods.description: Sets the parameters p, q, g.

methods.name: DH_set_length
methods.description: Sets the private key length.

methods.name: DH_generate_key
methods.description: Generates a public/private key pair.

methods.name: dh_compute_key
methods.description: Computes the shared secret given a peer's public key.

methods.name: dh_compute_key_detailed
methods.description: Performs the core computation of the shared key.

methods.name: dh_compute_key_padded_no_self_test
methods.description: Computes shared key with padding, without self-test.

methods.name: DH_compute_key_padded
methods.description: Computes shared key with padding, with self-test.

methods.name: DH_compute_key
methods.description: Computes the shared secret.

methods.name: DH_compute_key_hashed
methods.description: Computes the shared secret and hashes it with a digest.

methods.name: DH_size
methods.description: Returns the size of the shared key in bytes.

methods.name: DH_num_bits
methods.description: Returns the number of bits in the prime p.

methods.name: DH_up_ref
methods.description: Increments the reference count of the DH object.

methods.name: DH_get_rfc7919_2048
methods.description: Returns a DH object with parameters from RFC 7919 appendix A.1.
